operators.crossover: whole-block, d = rng.random(3) in block order guidance|inner_loop|mixing, d < 0.5 -> parent A (ranked[i])
operators.mutation: hit = rng.random(29) < 0.15; g[hit] += rng.normal(0, 0.08, hit.sum()); clip [0,1]
operators.draw_order_per_child: select i, select j (!= i), crossover rng.random(3), mutation rng.random(29), rng.normal(n_hit)
